```{r, echo=TRUE}

## ==========================================================
## TFCE for between-subject 2 x 2 factorial design in R
##
## Model:
##   Amplitude ~ FactorA + FactorB + Interaction
##
## Tests:
##   1. Factor A main effect
##   2. Factor B main effect
##   3. A x B interaction
##
## Permutation:
##   Freedman-Lane
## ==========================================================

rm(list = ls())

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(fields)

source("../R/tfce_transform.R")

cat("\nStarting TFCE 2 x 2 between-subject analysis...\n")

## ==========================================================
## -1. Load data
## ==========================================================

designTable <- read_csv("../data/03_designTable.csv")
EEGlong     <- read_csv("../data/03_EEGdata_long.csv")

print(names(designTable))
print(names(EEGlong))

## ==========================================================
## 0. Merge EEG data with design table
## ==========================================================

dat <- EEGlong %>%
  left_join(designTable, by = "Subject") %>%
  mutate(
    Subject     = factor(Subject),
    Channel     = factor(Channel),
    FactorA     = as.numeric(FactorA),
    FactorB     = as.numeric(FactorB),
    Interaction = as.numeric(Interaction)
  )

channels <- unique(EEGlong$Channel)
times    <- sort(unique(EEGlong$Time))

nChan <- length(channels)
nTime <- length(times)

## ==========================================================
## Function: compute t-map for one effect
## ==========================================================

compute_tmap_2x2 <- function(data, effect_name) {
  
  res <- data %>%
    group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
    summarise(
      t_value = coef(summary(
        lm(Amplitude ~ FactorA + FactorB + Interaction)
      ))[effect_name, "t value"],
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  tvec <- res %>%
    mutate(
      Channel = factor(Channel, levels = channels),
      Time    = factor(Time, levels = times)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Channel, Time) %>%
    pull(t_value)
  
  matrix(
    tvec,
    nrow = nChan,
    ncol = nTime,
    byrow = TRUE,
    dimnames = list(channels, times)
  )
}

## ==========================================================
## Function: run TFCE analysis for one effect
## ==========================================================

run_tfce_effect <- function(effect_name, reduced_formula, effect_label) {
  
  cat("\n==========================================================\n")
  cat("Running TFCE for:", effect_label, "\n")
  cat("==========================================================\n")
  
  ## Observed t-map
  cat("Step 1: Computing observed t-map...\n")
  
  t_Obs <- compute_tmap_2x2(dat, effect_name)
  
  ## Observed TFCE map
  cat("Step 2: Computing observed TFCE map...\n")
  
  TFCE_Obs <- tfce_transform(
    t_Obs,
    E  = 0.66,
    H  = 2,
    dh = 0.1
  )
  
  ## ========================================================
  ## Freedman-Lane permutation
  ## ========================================================
  
  set.seed(123)
  
  nPerm <- 999
  TFCE_permMax <- rep(NA_real_, nPerm)
  
  cat("Step 3: Precomputing reduced-model fitted values and residuals...\n")
  
  FL_parts <- dat %>%
    group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      
      df <- .x
      
      lm_red <- lm(reduced_formula, data = df)
      
      df$Y_hat_red <- fitted(lm_red)
      df$resid_red <- residuals(lm_red)
      
      df
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  cat("Step 4: Starting Freedman-Lane permutation testing...\n")
  
  for (p in seq_len(nPerm)) {
    
    perm_dat <- FL_parts %>%
      group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
      group_modify(~ {
        
        df <- .x
        
        perm_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(df)))
        
        df$Amplitude <- df$Y_hat_red + df$resid_red[perm_idx]
        
        df
      }) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    t_perm <- compute_tmap_2x2(perm_dat, effect_name)
    
    TFCE_perm <- tfce_transform(
      t_perm,
      E  = 0.66,
      H  = 2,
      dh = 0.1
    )
    
    TFCE_permMax[p] <- max(abs(TFCE_perm), na.rm = TRUE)
    
    if (p %% 50 == 0) {
      cat("Permutation", p, "of", nPerm, "\n")
    }
  }
  
  cat("Permutation testing completed.\n")
  
  ## ========================================================
  ## TFCE-corrected significance
  ## ========================================================
  
  cat("Step 5: Computing TFCE-corrected significance...\n")
  
  alpha <- 0.05
  
  maxTFCE <- sort(c(
    TFCE_permMax,
    max(abs(TFCE_Obs), na.rm = TRUE)
  ))
  
  maxTFCEcrit <- maxTFCE[round(nPerm * (1 - alpha))]
  
  Mask <- abs(TFCE_Obs) >= maxTFCEcrit
  
  P_Values <- matrix(
    NA,
    nrow = nChan,
    ncol = nTime,
    dimnames = dimnames(TFCE_Obs)
  )
  
  for (ch in seq_len(nChan)) {
    for (t in seq_len(nTime)) {
      P_Values[ch, t] <-
        (sum(TFCE_permMax >= abs(TFCE_Obs[ch, t]), na.rm = TRUE) + 1) /
        (nPerm + 1)
    }
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("Critical TFCE value = %.4f\n", maxTFCEcrit))
  
  Results <- list(
    Obs          = t_Obs,
    TFCE_Obs     = TFCE_Obs,
    TFCE_Null    = TFCE_permMax,
    maxTFCEcrit  = maxTFCEcrit,
    P_Values     = P_Values,
    Mask         = Mask,
    alpha        = alpha,
    nPerm        = nPerm,
    model        = "Amplitude ~ FactorA + FactorB + Interaction",
    test         = effect_label,
    times        = times,
    channels     = channels
  )
  
  return(Results)
}

## ==========================================================
## Run three effects
## ==========================================================

Results_A <- run_tfce_effect(
  effect_name     = "FactorA",
  reduced_formula = Amplitude ~ FactorB + Interaction,
  effect_label    = "Factor A main effect"
)

Results_B <- run_tfce_effect(
  effect_name     = "FactorB",
  reduced_formula = Amplitude ~ FactorA + Interaction,
  effect_label    = "Factor B main effect"
)

Results_Int <- run_tfce_effect(
  effect_name     = "Interaction",
  reduced_formula = Amplitude ~ FactorA + FactorB,
  effect_label    = "A x B interaction"
)

## ==========================================================
## Helper plotting function
## ==========================================================

plot_eeg_map <- function(mat, title) {
  
  fields::image.plot(
    x = times,
    y = seq_len(nChan),
    z = t(mat),
    xlab = "Time (ms)",
    ylab = "Channel",
    main = title,
    axes = FALSE
  )
  
  axis(1, at = seq(-200, 800, by = 200))
  axis(
    2,
    at = seq_len(nChan),
    labels = channels,
    las = 2,
    cex.axis = 0.6
  )
  box()
}

## ==========================================================
## Plot significant corrected t-maps
## ==========================================================

mA <- Results_A$Obs
mA[!Results_A$Mask] <- 0
plot_eeg_map(mA, "TFCE-corrected Factor A Effect")

mB <- Results_B$Obs
mB[!Results_B$Mask] <- 0
plot_eeg_map(mB, "TFCE-corrected Factor B Effect")

mInt <- Results_Int$Obs
mInt[!Results_Int$Mask] <- 0
plot_eeg_map(mInt, "TFCE-corrected A x B Interaction")

## ==========================================================
## Plot observed TFCE maps
## ==========================================================

plot_eeg_map(Results_A$TFCE_Obs, "Observed TFCE Map: Factor A")
plot_eeg_map(Results_B$TFCE_Obs, "Observed TFCE Map: Factor B")
plot_eeg_map(Results_Int$TFCE_Obs, "Observed TFCE Map: A x B Interaction")

## ==========================================================
## Save results
## ==========================================================

if (!dir.exists("../results")) {
  dir.create("../results")
}

save(
  Results_A,
  Results_B,
  Results_Int,
  file = "../results/03_TFCE_between_subject_2x2_results.RData"
)

cat("\nTFCE 2 x 2 between-subject analysis completed.\n")
cat("Saved results: ../results/03_TFCE_between_subject_2x2_results.RData\n")
```
